worker-artifact-upload-recovery.intro: Review unpublished artifact uploads for this node. A finished original attempt can be closed while its files, history, and storage reservation are retained.
worker-artifact-upload-recovery.empty: No unsealed artifact uploads remain for this credential. Other unresolved work can still block rotation.
worker-artifact-upload-recovery.acknowle: I understand this upload stays incomplete and its files and history are retained.
worker-artifact-upload-recovery.stale: These upload details could not be verified for the current node. Refresh the node or retry the upload list.
worker-artifact-upload-recovery.pending: The original upload operation needs confirmation before other changes.
worker-artifact-upload-recovery.receipt: Incomplete upload closed. Review the node again before rotating its credential.
worker-artifact-upload-recovery.conflict: The upload or original attempt changed. Refresh the list and review its current evidence.
